title: ConsentGrant
description: What a party agreed to, when, in what language, and on what evidence. Separate from the party record so consent can be withdrawn without rewriting identity.

scopeParcelId.description: Null means the grant covers the party's participation generally rather than one parcel.

permittedUses.description: CONSENT-001 record-level permitted uses. OPEN QUESTION 4: this list must come from the form the party physically signs, in their language — not from a schema written in advance.

languageTag.description: BCP 47. Consent obtained in a language the party does not read is not consent, so this is required, not optional.

method.description: Witnessed verbal and thumbprint are included because literacy cannot be assumed. Excluding them would exclude the people this platform exists to work with.

withdrawnAt.description: CONSENT-003. Set on withdrawal; the row is never deleted. All processing under permittedUses must stop from this instant.

withdrawalReason.description: Optional and must remain so. Requiring a reason to withdraw is a form of obstruction.
